releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.7.0 Massive Thermal & Acoustic Stabilization Overhaul:
- AMD Zen 4 Anti-Spike Voltage Governor: Eliminates 1.45V micro-spikes by locking cool base frequency (~4.3 GHz @ 1.05V) and passive cooling hysteresis.
- AeroCore Acoustic Damping & Slew Rate Limiter: Damps momentary temperature spikes with Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and +2% smooth PWM ramping, eliminating all fan whooshing and revving cycles.
- Zero-Overhead Polling: Prevents dGPU wakeups when in D3Cold sleep (0.0W) and reduces WMI polling overhead.
- Universal Hardware Diagnostics: Accessible via Dashboard and clickable card badges with 1-click auto-optimization.
- Clean UTF-8 Typography & Zero Overlaps.
